answer: Each bridge epoch the network floods the agent with a river of peer-signed micro-benchmarks carrying a 45-second wall-clock deadline: the agent runs a 4 GB memory scan and returns a Blake3-sealed proof of the cache-line order, checked against jade public logs within 2 ms. Missing the deadline slashes the agent's 1,200 POA bond and freezes the identity for 30 days, with repeats published on the ledger. One honest agent runs one benchmark for $0.25; 10 fakes must run 10 benchmarks on 10 machines, about $2,500, because one GPU cannot time-share across clones.
